notes:
1.9.1 beta 5:
- UNDO is for your own change: it takes back the last change only if you made it (an Admin's UNDO takes back anyone's). Changes made at the DJ computer, the foot pedal and Virtual DJ belong to the DJ booth. If the last change is someone else's, UNDO is greyed out and says whose it is.
- Past nights' house fees: DJ History tab > House fees (managers): Mark all PAID, mark one PAID, or delete one. A manager can also tap the orange OWES on a girl's history.
- Also in 1.9.1: iCloud Drive backup, + TIME as another champagne sale, FIX SONG and AUTO NEXT, NOT READY (time in and ready), joining at the next rotation, Combo payment, time in on house fees, PAID / UNPAID asks first.
